name: 13837-guidedjson-8b-1gpu
hardware: 1x H100 80GB HBM3 (one GPU of an a3 node, --gres=gpu:1).
parallelism: TP=1, PP=1, DP=1. One in-process vLLM engine through guidellm's `vllm_python` backend, so there is no HTTP round trip.
architecture: LlamaForCausalLM dense decoder, 32 layers, 32 query heads, 8 KV heads, hidden 4096, bf16, 8.03B params = 16.1 GB of weights.
load_profile: constant (OPEN loop), rate=10 req/s, warmup the first 20% by completion and cooldown the last 10%, bounded at 1200 requests with a 900 s safety cap -- ~120 s of arrivals, 840 requests measured.
workload: guidellm `synthetic_text`, single turn, no prefix_buckets. Prompt exactly 128 tokens (min = max), output exactly 64 (min = max). Every request carries the same flat 8-field `SupportTicket` JSON schema, declared in scenario.json as `spec.backend.sampling_params.structured_outputs.json`, with `temperature: 0.0`, `ignore_eos: true` and `request_format: "plain"`.
purpose: A support-ticket tagging service on one GPU, turning short tickets into fixed JSON fields at ten requests per second.
launch:
# ENGINE: commit 1d35662e6dc199431bfe4004cc84d66fd9b297b1 (v0.7.3-103-g1d35662e6d), a built
#   checkout; env.yaml says where it lives on this machine.
#
# FLAT YAML ONLY: any line starting with a space is skipped, so a block-style mapping here
#   parses to nothing and the engine silently starts without it.
#
# `VLLM_USE_V1=0` is not an AsyncEngineArgs field and cannot be written here; pass it in the
#   environment.

# PIN, DO NOT SUBSTITUTE. Ungated mirror of meta-llama/Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct.
model: NousResearch/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 1
dtype: bfloat16
max-model-len: 4096
max-num-seqs: 256
enable-prefix-caching: false
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.90
